Container.Name: wishes
Container.Overview: Wishes: self-hosted family wishlists for kids and adults. Families, shared and hidden lists, gift claiming, link autofill from Amazon/Walmart/Target/Kohl's, price-drop alerts, OIDC and 2FA, optional AI gift ideas.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: Public URL, e.g. https://wishes.example.com (needed for OIDC redirects)

Config.Name: Allow sign-up
Config.Description: Let anyone with the URL create an account (first user is always admin)

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: e.g. https://auth.example.com for Tinyauth, Authelia, Authentik, Pocket ID

Config.Name: Trusted email header
Config.Description: Forward-auth header with the user's email (e.g. Remote-Email). Only set if Wishes is reachable solely through your proxy.

Config.Name: Price check hours
Config.Description: How often each linked item's price is re-checked for deal alerts (0 = off)

Config.Name: Compare stores
Config.Description: Look for each wish at Walmart and Amazon during price checks

Config.Name: FlareSolverr URL
Config.Description: Optional. A FlareSolverr container (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191) used for store pages behind a browser check. Can also be set in Settings → Server.

Config.Name: Scraping service URL
Config.Description: Optional fallback scraping API with {url} as the page placeholder
